name: Blue crab
description: Blue crab (Callinectes sapidus), tracked as its own compartment by the source. The estuary's famous benthic omnivore, eating deposit-feeding worms and clams, suspension feeders and sediment detritus - plus other blue crabs (the source's within-compartment cannibalism flow is omitted here). Eaten by striped bass. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the annual mean in mgC/m2.
